Organize the guidelines for validation reports under the regulation or policy they come from, edit them to align with your organization's requirements, and add them to your report templates to ensure that they are ready for use.

To set up validation guidelines, you'll need to complete these two steps in sequence:

1. [Set up validation guidelines](#set-up-validation-guidelines)
2. [Add guidelines to templates](#add-guidelines-to-templates)

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] You are a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} or [{{< fa circle-check >}} Validator]{.bubble}, or assigned another role with sufficient permissions to perform the tasks in this guide.[^1]

:::

## Set up validation guidelines

{{< include /guide/validation/_validation-guidelines.qmd >}}

Guidelines are organized into guideline sets, which belong to a regulation or policy:

- A **guideline set** is a named collection of guidelines for one or more document types.
- A set is made up of **groups**, and each group holds **guidelines**.

Your existing guidelines are available in a **Validation Guidelines** set under the default **Validation Guidelines** regulation, with one group for each of your former risk areas. Templates, validation reports, and assessments already made against guidelines are unchanged, and artifacts keep their risk area.

::: {.callout title="Does your organization still manage guidelines by risk area?"}
If **Risk Areas & Validation Guidelines** is listed under {{< fa shield >}} Governance in your settings, follow the steps to [manage guidelines by risk area](#manage-guidelines-by-risk-area) instead.
:::

### Manage guideline sets

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa shield >}} Governance, select **Regulations & Policies**.[^2]

3. Click the regulation or policy you want to manage guideline sets for.

4. Under **Guidelines**, add, edit, clone, archive, restore, or delete a guideline set:

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Add guideline sets

a. Click **{{< fa plus >}} Add Guideline Set**.

b. Provide the:

    - **Guideline Set Name**
    - **Document Types** — Only validation reports are currently supported.
    - (Optional) **Description**

c. Click **Add Guideline Set** to save the set.

d. Click the new set to add groups and guidelines to it.[^3]

#### Edit guideline sets

a. Hover over the guideline set you want to edit.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit**.

c. Make your desired changes to the set's name, document types, or description.

d. Click **Edit Guideline Set** to apply your changes.

#### Clone guideline sets

a. Hover over the guideline set you want to clone.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa copy >}} Clone**.

c. (Optional) Make changes to the name, document types, or description of the copy.

d. Click **Clone Guideline Set** to save a copy of the set.

    The copy holds the same groups and guidelines as the original, in the same order.

#### Archive guideline sets

a. Hover over the guideline set you want to archive.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa box-archive >}} Archive**.

c. Click **Archive** to confirm archival.

    Once archived, the set moves to the **Archived Guideline Sets** section, and its guidelines are no longer offered when you add guidelines to a template. Templates that already use those guidelines, and assessments already made against them, are unchanged.

#### Restore guideline sets

a. Under **Archived Guideline Sets**, hover over the guideline set you want to restore.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa undo >}} Restore**.

    Once restored, the set's guidelines are offered again when you add guidelines to a template.

#### Delete guideline sets

::: {.callout-important title="Deleting a guideline set also deletes its groups and guidelines, and removes those guidelines from any associated templates without creating a new version of the template."}
You are unable to delete a guideline set while any of its guidelines have assessments in validation reports assigned to them, or are held by a locked version of a document.
:::

a. Hover over the guideline set you want to delete.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete**]{.red}.

c. Review the confirmation, which lists any guidelines that prevent the deletion, and any templates that use the set's guidelines.

d. If templates are listed, select the checkbox to confirm that the guidelines will be removed from them.

e. Confirm permanent deletion of the guideline set.

:::

### Manage groups and guidelines

Groups and guidelines are managed on the page for their guideline set. The page is read-only until you click **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Guidelines**, and none of your changes are saved until you click **Save Changes**.

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa shield >}} Governance, select **Regulations & Policies**.

3. Click the regulation or policy, then click the guideline set you want to manage.

4. Click **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Guidelines**.

5. Make your changes to the set:

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Add groups

a. Click **{{< fa plus >}} Add Group**.

b. Provide a **Name** and an optional **Description** for your group.

    Each group in a set needs a different name.

c. Click **Save** to add the group to the set.

#### Add guidelines

a. On the group you want to add a guideline to, click **{{< fa plus >}}** and select **Guideline**.

b. Provide a **Title** and **Description** for your guideline.

c. Click **Add Guideline** to insert your guideline at the end of that group.

#### Edit groups or guidelines

To edit a group:

a. On the group you want to edit, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** and select **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Group**.

b. Make your desired changes to the group's **Name** and **Description**.

c. Click **Save** to apply your changes.

To edit a guideline:

a. Expand the group by clicking on it.

b. Edit the guideline's title directly in its row.

c. Expand the guideline by clicking on its row, then edit its description in place.

#### Reorder or move

- To reorder groups within the set, drag a group by its **{{< fa grip-vertical >}}** handle to its new position.
- To reorder guidelines within a group, drag a guideline by its **{{< fa grip-vertical >}}** handle to its new position.
- To move a guideline to another group, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** on the guideline and select the group under **Move to Group**.

    A guideline moved to another group is placed at the end of that group.

The order you set is also the order groups and guidelines are listed in when you add guidelines to a template.

#### Delete groups or guidelines

::: {.callout-important title="Deleting a guideline will remove it from any associated templates without creating a new version of the template."}
- Deleting a group also deletes the guidelines in that group.
- You are unable to delete any guidelines with assessments in validation reports assigned to them, or that are held by a locked version of a document.
:::

- To delete a group, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** on the group and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete Group**]{.red}. Review the confirmation, which lists any guidelines that prevent the deletion and any templates that use the group's guidelines, then confirm.
- To delete a guideline, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** on the guideline and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete Guideline**]{.red}.

:::

6. Click **Save Changes** to apply all of your changes to the guideline set.

    To discard your changes instead, click **Cancel**, then **Yes, Discard Changes**.

Once guidelines are set up, you can then add them to your validation report templates.[^4]

### Manage guidelines by risk area

::: {.callout}
These steps apply only if **Risk Areas & Validation Guidelines** is listed under {{< fa shield >}} Governance in your settings.
:::

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa shield >}} Governance, select **Risk Areas & Validation Guidelines**.

3. Add, edit, or delete risk areas and their associated guidelines as required.

    - Once a risk area is added, you can then manage guidelines associated with that risk area.
    - Once guidelines are set up, you can then add them to your validation report templates.[^4]

#### Manage risk areas

{{< include /guide/validation/_risk-areas.qmd >}}

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa shield >}} Governance, select **Risk Areas & Validation Guidelines**.

::: {.panel-tabset}

##### Add risk areas

{{< include /guide/validation/_add-risk-areas.qmd >}}

##### Edit risk areas

a. Hover over the risk area you want to edit.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Risk Area**.

c. Make your desired changes to the risk area's **Name** and **Description**.

d. Click **Save Risk Area** to apply your changes.

##### Delete risk areas

::: {.callout-important}
Any guidelines associated with a risk area will need to be deleted before the risk area can be removed.
:::

a. Hover over the risk area you want to remove.

b. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete Risk Area**]{.red}.

c. Click **Yes, Delete Risk Area** to confirm permanent deletion of that risk area.

:::

#### Manage guidelines for a risk area

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa shield >}} Governance, select **Risk Areas & Validation Guidelines**.

::: {.panel-tabset}

##### Add guidelines

{{< include /guide/validation/_add-validation-guidelines.qmd >}}

##### Edit guidelines

a. Expand the menu for a risk area by clicking **{{< fa chevron-down >}}**.

b. Hover over the guideline you want to edit.

c. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Guideline**.

d. Make your desired changes to the risk area's **Title** and **Description**.

e. Click **Save Guideline** to apply your changes.

##### Delete guidelines

::: {.callout-important title="Deleting a guideline will remove it from any associated templates without creating a new version of the template."}
You are also unable to delete any guidelines with assessments in validation reports assigned to them.
:::

a. Expand the menu for a risk area by clicking **{{< fa chevron-down >}}**.

b. Hover over the guideline you want to delete.

c. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select [**{{< fa trash-can >}} Delete Guideline**]{.red}.

d. Click **Yes, Delete Guideline** to confirm permanent deletion of that guideline.

:::

## Add guidelines to templates

::: {.callout title="To configure validation templates, you must have sufficient guideline and template permissions."}
By default, the [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} role has all these permissions.[^5]
:::

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa file >}} Documents, select **Templates**.[^6]

3. Select the **Validation** tab, then click on the template you want to edit.

4. On the template details page, click **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Outline**.

5. For the section you'd like to add a guideline to,[^7] click **{{< fa plus >}}** and select **{{< fa circle-check >}} Guideline Block** under **Content**.

6. Select the **Guideline Set** to pick from, expand a group, and select the guidelines you'd like to add to that section.

    - Your selection is kept when you switch to another guideline set.
    - Archived guideline sets are not offered.
    - If your organization manages guidelines by risk area, expand a risk area instead.

7. Click **Add # Guideline(s)** to save your changes.

8. When you're done, click **Create New Version** to view a side-by-side comparison of your changes with the previous version:
   - Add a description in **Version Notes** to track your changes.
   - Click **Save** to create the new version.

    Once saved, your new template version with the modified guidelines becomes available for use with your validation reports.
